months.summary: Garland police reported 602 incidents in February 2022 across categories including murder, sexual assault, aggravated assault, robbery, burglary, theft, motor vehicle theft and criminal mischief. Theft was the most frequently reported category with 215 incidents, followed by burglary with 148 incidents. The most common offences were theft with 92 reports, vehicle burglary with 76 reports, and vandalism with 74 reports. Districts 23 and 24 each recorded 41 reported incidents, the highest concentration in the city.

Garland police reported 756 incidents in March 2022, compared with 602 in February 2022. Theft rose by 70 incidents and burglary by 47 incidents, the two largest increases among reported categories. Vehicle burglary was the most frequently reported specific offense at 134 incidents, while districts 23 and 43 each recorded 48 incidents.

Garland police reported 785 incidents in April 2022, an increase of 29 from the 756 reported in March 2022. Aggravated assault and motor vehicle theft each increased by 16 incidents, while theft rose by 15 incidents; information reports declined by 7. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 300 incidents, followed by burglary at 190 incidents, with vehicle burglary and unauthorized vehicle use among the most common individual offences.

Garland police reported 749 incidents in May 2022, down 36 from 785 in April. Burglary decreased notably with 24 fewer reported incidents, while Information Reports increased by 14. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 290 incidents, followed by Burglary at 166 and Motor Vehicle Theft at 93, with the highest concentration of reported incidents in District 31.

In June 2022, Garland police received reports of 724 incidents, a decrease of 25 from May 2022's 749 reports. Burglary increased notably with 189 reported incidents compared to 166 in the previous month, while Information Reports declined from 57 to 31. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 277 incidents, followed by burglary and motor vehicle theft at 93 reported incidents.

Garland police reported 729 incidents in July 2022, an increase of 5 from the 724 reported in June 2022. Criminal Mischief rose notably with 89 incidents compared to 77 the previous month, while Theft declined from 277 to 268 incidents. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 268 incidents, followed by Burglary at 188 incidents, with Murder reported 3 times during the month.

In August 2022, Garland police reported 758 incidents across the categories tracked in this report, an increase of 29 from July 2022. Burglary reported incidents rose notably, increasing 27 from the previous month to 215, while criminal mischief decreased 23 to 66. Sexual assault reported incidents increased 9 to reach 15, the highest number in this category during the comparison period. Theft remained the most frequently reported category with 272 incidents.

Garland police reported 707 incidents in September 2022, a decrease of 51 from the 758 reported in August 2022. Burglary declined notably with 160 reported incidents compared to 215 the previous month, while Criminal Mischief increased to 116 from 66. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 252 incidents, followed by Burglary at 160 and Criminal Mischief at 116.

Garland police reported 818 incidents in October 2022, an increase of 111 from 707 in September 2022. Burglary showed the largest increase with 228 reported incidents compared to 160 the previous month, while theft also rose to 296 from 252, and criminal mischief decreased to 96 from 116. Theft remained the most frequently reported category overall, followed by vehicle burglary with 115 incidents and vandalism with 96 incidents.

In November 2022, Garland police reported 626 incidents, a decrease from 818 in October 2022. The largest changes came in theft, which fell to 224 from 296, and burglary, which declined to 164 from 228. Theft remained the most frequently reported category, followed by vehicle burglary at 89 incidents and unauthorized vehicle use at 87 incidents. District 43 recorded the highest number of reported incidents with 43.

Garland police received reports of 596 incidents in December 2022, a decrease of 30 from the 626 reported in November. Burglary declined notably with 131 reports compared to 164 the previous month, while aggravated assault increased to 27 reports from 14. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 209 incidents, followed by burglary at 131 and motor vehicle theft at 115, with unauthorized vehicle use accounting for 102 of those motor vehicle thefts.

Garland police received reports of 696 incidents in January 2023, an increase of 100 from the 596 reported in December 2022. Theft showed the largest increase with 254 reported incidents, followed by Criminal Mischief with 93 incidents. Unauthorized Vehicle Use and Theft were tied as the most frequently reported offences, each accounting for 106 incidents.

In February 2023, Garland police reported 617 incidents, a decrease of 79 from the 696 reported in January. Theft declined by 31 incidents and motor vehicle theft fell by 26, while robbery dropped significantly from 17 incidents to 6. The most frequently reported offences were unauthorized vehicle use with 86 incidents, theft at 84, and shoplifting at 75, with district 43 recording the highest number of reported incidents at 48.

Garland police reported 681 reported incidents in March 2023, an increase of 64 from 617 in February 2023. Theft rose substantially with 268 reported incidents, while aggravated assault declined to 20 from 36 the previous month. Motor vehicle theft and burglary also increased, with 114 and 159 reported incidents respectively. District 46 recorded the highest concentration of reported incidents with 57.

In April 2023, Garland police reported 654 incidents, a decrease of 27 from the 681 reported in March 2023. Theft declined significantly with 221 reported incidents compared to 268 in the previous month, while aggravated assault increased from 20 to 38 incidents. The most frequently reported offences were vehicle burglary at 92 incidents and theft at 88 incidents, with District 23 accounting for 61 of the month's reported incidents.

In May 2023, Garland police reported 731 incidents, an increase of 77 from the 654 reported in April 2023. Motor Vehicle Theft showed the largest change, rising to 184 incidents from 103 the previous month, while Aggravated Assault and Burglary each declined by 5 incidents. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 223 incidents, followed by Motor Vehicle Theft at 184 and Burglary at 159, with Unauthorized Vehicle Use accounting for 129 of the motor vehicle theft reports.

Garland police received 617 reported incident reports in June 2023, a decrease of 114 from the 731 reported in May 2023. Motor Vehicle Theft showed the largest shift, dropping from 184 reported incidents to 78, while Information Reports increased from 28 to 34. Theft remained the most frequently reported category with 222 incidents, and the three busiest districts were 46, 26, and 23.

Garland police reported 733 incidents in July 2023, an increase of 116 from June's 617 reported incidents. Burglary increased by 48 incidents and Motor Vehicle Theft rose by 44 incidents, while Theft declined by 8 incidents. Vehicle Burglary was the single most common offense with 114 reported incidents, and District 46 experienced the highest concentration of reported incidents with 51 cases.

In August 2023, Garland police reported 689 incidents, a decrease of 44 from July 2023. Criminal Mischief showed the largest movement, declining from 102 to 60 reported incidents, while Motor Vehicle Theft fell from 122 to 100. Theft increased from 214 to 233 incidents and Aggravated Assault rose from 36 to 47 incidents, making it the category with the most notable growth. Vehicle Burglary was the most frequently reported specific offense with 113 incidents.

Garland police reported 640 incidents in September 2023, down from 689 in August 2023. Burglary declined significantly with 151 reported incidents compared to 198 the previous month, while theft also decreased from 233 to 201. Criminal mischief increased notably from 60 to 87 incidents, marking the most substantial upward movement among major categories. Vehicle burglary and theft tied as the most frequently reported offences at 91 each.

In October 2023, Garland police reported 667 incidents across major categories, an increase of 27 from September 2023. Motor Vehicle Theft showed the largest increase, rising from 110 to 140 reported incidents, while Aggravated Assault declined from 34 to 21. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 223 incidents, followed by Burglary at 157, with Motor Vehicle Theft continuing to rise at 140 reported incidents for the month.

Garland police reported 577 incidents in November 2023, a decrease of 90 from October 2023. Motor vehicle theft saw the largest category decline, dropping 38 incidents, while theft and criminal mischief also decreased notably. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 190 incidents, followed by burglary at 148 incidents, with District 24 accounting for 50 of the month's reported incidents.

Garland police reported 617 incidents in December 2023, an increase of 40 from November's 577 reported incidents. Theft rose notably by 22 incidents to reach 212 total, while aggravated assault increased by 19 incidents to 32 and motor vehicle theft increased by 19 incidents to 121. The most frequently reported offences were theft, unauthorized vehicle use, and vehicle burglary, with theft representing the largest single category at 212 reported incidents.

Garland police received reports of 585 reported incidents in January 2024, a decrease of 32 from the 617 reported in December 2023. Burglary declined by 18 incidents and motor vehicle theft fell by 17, while information reports increased by 11. Theft remained the most frequently reported category with 215 incidents, followed by burglary with 132 incidents.

In February 2024, Garland police reported 557 incidents, a decrease of 28 from the 585 reported in January. Burglary declined by 17 incidents to 115, while criminal mischief increased by 16 to 79. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 204 incidents, followed by burglary at 115 and motor vehicle theft at 104.

In March 2024, Garland police reported 582 incidents, an increase of 25 from the 557 reported in February 2024. Theft rose significantly with 32 more incidents than the previous month, while motor vehicle theft decreased substantially with 39 fewer incidents; burglary and aggravated assault also increased with 20 and 11 additional incidents respectively. Theft remained the most frequently reported category with 236 incidents, followed by burglary with 135 incidents and criminal mischief with 72 incidents.

In April 2024, Garland police reported 613 incidents, an increase of 31 from March 2024. Motor Vehicle Theft reported 94 incidents, up 29 from the previous month, while Burglary increased by 25 to reach 160 incidents. Theft, the most frequently reported category, declined by 20 incidents to 216. Among specific offences, Theft accounted for 91 reported incidents, followed by Vehicle Burglary with 80 incidents.

Garland police reported 594 incidents in May 2024, down from 613 in April 2024. Theft was the largest category with 203 reported incidents, followed by burglary with 153 incidents, though both decreased from the previous month. Sexual assault reported incidents increased notably to 16 in May compared to 6 in April, marking the most significant category increase during the period.

Garland police reported 588 incidents in June 2024, a decrease of 6 from the 594 reported in May 2024. Burglary declined significantly with 119 reported incidents compared to 153 in the previous month, while aggravated assault increased from 30 to 40 incidents. Theft remained the most frequently reported category with 213 incidents, followed by burglary with 119 incidents.

Garland police reported 596 incidents in July 2024, compared with 588 in June 2024. Burglary reported incidents increased notably, rising from 119 to 150, while aggravated assault reports declined from 40 to 24. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 219 incidents, followed by burglary at 150 and motor vehicle theft at 88.

In August 2024, Garland police reported 609 incidents across the tracked categories, an increase of 13 from the 596 reported in July 2024. Burglary decreased notably by 16 incidents to 134, while Information Reports rose by 15 to 36 and Aggravated Assault increased by 6 to 30. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 215 incidents, and district 24 accounted for 62 of all reported incidents during the month.

Garland police received reports of 540 incidents in September 2024, down from 609 in August 2024. Theft declined by 32 incidents and burglary fell by 25 incidents, the largest decreases among all categories. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 183 incidents, followed by burglary at 109 incidents and motor vehicle theft at 83 incidents.

Garland police reported 602 incidents in October 2024, an increase of 62 from the 540 reported in September 2024. Theft rose notably with 233 incidents, while motor vehicle theft declined to 67 incidents and robbery dropped to 11 incidents. The most frequently reported offence was theft at 110 incidents, and District 31 recorded the highest concentration of reported incidents with 45.

Garland police reported 469 incidents in November 2024, a decrease of 133 from the 602 reported in October. Theft declined notably with 64 fewer incidents, while burglary fell by 22 and criminal mischief dropped by 20. Theft remained the most frequently reported category with 169 incidents, followed by burglary with 109 and motor vehicle theft with 73, with district 24 accounting for 41 of the month's reported incidents.

Garland police reported 483 incidents in December 2024, an increase of 14 from the 469 reported in November 2024. Criminal Mischief showed the largest movement, rising to 71 incidents from 53 the previous month, while Theft declined slightly from 169 to 162. Theft remained the most frequently reported category overall at 162 incidents, followed by Burglary at 113 incidents.

Garland police reported 486 incidents in January 2025, compared with 483 in December 2024. Theft and burglary increased notably, with 182 and 134 incidents respectively, while motor vehicle theft fell to 44 from 71 and criminal mischief dropped to 46 from 71. Vehicle burglary was among the most frequently reported offences, and district 23 recorded the highest concentration of reported incidents with 40.

Garland police reported 451 incidents in February 2025, down from 486 in January 2025. Burglary decreased notably with 103 reported incidents compared with 134 the previous month, while motor vehicle theft increased to 61 from 44. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 181 incidents, followed by burglary and motor vehicle theft, with reported incidents concentrated in districts 32, 31 and 24.

Garland police reported 480 incidents in March 2025, an increase of 29 from the 451 reported in February. Burglary reported incidents rose notably from 103 to 132, while motor vehicle theft decreased from 61 to 38. Theft remained the most frequently reported category with 181 incidents, and sexual assault cases increased from 4 to 11.

Garland police reported 452 incidents in April 2025, down from 480 in March 2025. Theft and burglary both declined, with theft dropping 28 incidents and burglary falling 21 incidents, while motor vehicle theft increased 15 incidents. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 153 incidents, followed by burglary at 111 incidents, with district 31 accounting for 35 of the month's reported incidents.

Garland police reported 466 incidents in May 2025, an increase of 14 from the 452 reported in April. Theft increased substantially with 189 incidents compared to 153 the previous month, while criminal mischief decreased from 65 incidents to 46. The most frequently reported offences were theft at 87 incidents and shoplifting at 54 incidents, with district 31 accounting for 39 of the month's reported incidents.

Garland police reported 506 incidents in June 2025, an increase of 40 from the 466 reported in May 2025. Motor Vehicle Theft rose significantly with 71 incidents compared to 49 the previous month, while Criminal Mischief increased from 46 to 63 incidents; Theft was the only major category to decline, dropping from 189 to 178 incidents. District 31 accounted for 47 of the month's reported incidents, the highest concentration among all districts.

In July 2025, Garland police reported 523 incidents, an increase of 17 from the 506 reported in June 2025. Theft showed the largest movement, rising to 207 incidents from 178 the previous month, while aggravated assault declined from 30 to 16 incidents. Motor vehicle theft increased to 80 incidents, and burglary decreased to 106 from 116. Shoplifting emerged as a notable offence category with 63 reported incidents during the month.

Garland police reported 475 incidents in August 2025, a decrease of 48 from July's 523. Motor vehicle theft declined notably with 51 reported incidents compared to 80 the previous month, while burglary increased to 118 from 106. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 197 incidents, followed by burglary at 118, with the majority of reported incidents concentrated in districts 52, 56, and 31.

Garland police reported 465 incidents in September 2025, a decrease of 10 from August 2025. Motor Vehicle Theft declined notably with 34 incidents compared to 51 the previous month, while Robbery increased to 20 incidents from 6. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 189 incidents, followed by Burglary at 116, with Vehicle Burglary and Theft as the most common specific offences.

Garland police reported 513 incidents in October 2025, an increase of 48 from the 465 reported in September 2025. Motor vehicle theft increased notably, rising to 69 incidents from 34 the previous month, while robbery decreased to 5 incidents from 20. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 173 incidents, followed by burglary at 123 incidents.

Garland police reported 449 incidents in November 2025, down from 513 in October. Theft increased notably to 202 reported incidents, while motor vehicle theft declined to 43 and burglary fell to 98. The most frequently reported offences were theft with 80 incidents, vehicle burglary with 62, and both vandalism and shoplifting at 50 each.

Garland police reported 484 incidents in December 2025, an increase of 35 from the 449 reported in November. Burglary showed the largest movement, rising to 115 incidents from 98 the previous month, while Criminal Mischief increased to 63 from 52. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 199 incidents, with Vehicle Burglary and Vandalism among the most common specific offences.

In January 2026, Garland police received reports of 392 incidents, a decrease from 484 in December 2025. Theft declined significantly by 39 incidents, while criminal mischief fell 29 incidents and burglary dropped 27 incidents; motor vehicle theft increased by 11 incidents. The most frequently reported offences were theft at 160 incidents and shoplifting at 56 incidents, with district 52 accounting for 45 of the month's reported incidents.

In February 2026, Garland police received reports of 437 incidents across the categories tracked in this report, an increase of 45 from the 392 reported in January. Theft remained the most frequently reported category with 178 incidents, followed by burglary with 89 incidents; theft increased by 18 from the previous month while criminal mischief rose by 13. Among specific offences, shoplifting accounted for 54 of the theft-related reports, and unauthorized vehicle use represented 51 of the motor vehicle theft incidents. District 32 recorded the highest number of reported incidents with 41, compared to 31 in District 52 and 27 in District 43.

In March 2026, Garland police reported 483 incidents, an increase of 46 from the 437 reported in February. Burglary and criminal mischief each rose by 14 incidents, while theft increased by 10 incidents. Theft remained the most frequently reported category with 188 incidents, followed by burglary with 103 incidents, and District 31 recorded the highest concentration of reported incidents with 43.

Garland police received 465 reported incidents in April 2026, down from 483 in March 2026. Motor vehicle theft decreased notably, dropping from 63 incidents to 37, while criminal mischief increased from 61 to 74 incidents. Theft remained the most frequently reported category with 172 incidents, followed by burglary with 97 incidents. District 52 recorded the highest number of reported incidents at 38.

In May 2026, Garland police reported 417 incidents, down from 465 in April 2026. Criminal mischief declined substantially with 50 reported incidents compared to 74 the previous month, while aggravated assault fell from 41 to 22. Theft remained the most frequently reported category at 172 incidents, followed by burglary at 95, with shoplifting and vehicle burglary accounting for significant portions of theft and burglary reports respectively.

Garland police reported 442 incidents in June 2026, an increase of 25 from the 417 reported in May 2026. Theft rose notably by 27 incidents to 199 total, while motor vehicle theft increased by 15 incidents to 39, though robbery declined by 11 incidents to 3. The most frequently reported offences were theft with 92 incidents, vehicle burglary with 54, and shoplifting with 53.
